description: AI companion for FIFA World Cup 2026 — 18 tools covering matches, teams, venues, city guides, fan zones, visa info, head-to-head records, and more. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Telegram.

tool_signatures.name: compare_teams

city.description: Venue ID (e.g., 'metlife', 'azteca'), city name (e.g., 'Miami Gardens'), or metro area name (e.g., 'New York', 'Los Angeles'). Case-insensitive. Supports partial matching.
